text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills slipped to 56.05 percent from 57.30 percent at the last sale on October 2, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 7.187 million UAH 107.81 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.306 million UAH 94.338 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 71,867 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 32,446 T-bills were competitive and 39,421 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 4.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 59.90 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 2, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 35.45 million UAH 97,090 UAH
The central bank sold 460,348 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 373,049 T-bills were competitive and 87,299 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 8.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged up to 62.93 percent against 62.77 percent at the last sale on October 2, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 301 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 300 T-bills were competitive bids and one was a non-competitive bid.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 8.
